purpose: Authored POC balance, kept separate from the historical comparison data.

mortality.description: Background death probabilities are reduced to give players more time with work, family and specialist paths. After annual conversion, age 0 uses 6% of the historical comparison probability, ages 1-4 use 3%, ages 5-17 use 6%, ages 18-59 use 35%, ages 60-79 use 55%, and ages 80-94 use 80%. Ages 95-99 retain the comparison-derived tail assumption. These are authored game-balance settings, not reconstructed Alexandrian mortality rates.

notes: Apply the multiplier to the converted conditional annual death probability, not to an interval q or to remaining life expectancy.
Split source age bands wherever a balance boundary falls within them; the source 15–19 band becomes 15–17 and 18–19.
The raw mortality-model.json remains unchanged. Its life expectancy at birth describes the comparison source, not this easier play curve.
Early deaths remain possible. Adult background risks are also reduced; explicitly dangerous choices retain their separately disclosed authored fatal outcomes.
Completed-age death timing, the 95+ tail assumption and the maximum age of 100 remain unchanged.
Existing saved world revisions keep their original probabilities. This profile applies to new lives in the new pack.
